For [dataframe](/docs/shell/commands/categories/dataframe/).

<div class='command-title'>Show schema for a dataframe.</div>

> **warning This command requires a plugin**
> The `polars schema` command resides in the `polars` plugin.
> To use this command, you must install and register `nu_plugin_polars`.
> See the [Plugins](/docs/shell/book/plugins/) chapter in the book for more information.



## Command Type

`plugin`

## Signature

```> polars schema {flags} ```

## Flags

 -  `--datatype-list, -l`: Creates a lazy dataframe.


## Input/output types:

| input | output |
| ----- | ------ |
| any   | record |
## Examples

Dataframe schema
```nu
> [[a b]; [1 "foo"] [3 "bar"]] | polars into-df | polars schema
╭───┬─────╮
│ a │ i64 │
│ b │ str │
╰───┴─────╯
```
